question: Who is the illustrator that illustrated the least amount of cards? List the format of play of the cards that he/she illustrated.
evidence: format of the cards refers to format; illustrator refers to artist; the least amount of cards refers to MIN(artist)
clarification: Also keep rows that have no matching legalities record.
gold: SELECT T1.artist, T2.format FROM cards AS T1 LEFT JOIN legalities AS T2 ON T2.uuid = T1.uuid GROUP BY T1.artist ORDER BY COUNT(T1.id) ASC LIMIT 1
gold0: SELECT T1.artist, T2.format FROM cards AS T1 INNER JOIN legalities AS T2 ON T2.uuid = T1.uuid GROUP BY T1.artist ORDER BY COUNT(T1.id) ASC LIMIT 1

c.request:
Who is the illustrator that illustrated the least amount of cards? List the format of play of the cards that he/she illustrated.
Evidence: format of the cards refers to format; illustrator refers to artist; the least amount of cards refers to MIN(artist)
Also keep rows that have no matching legalities record.
c.sql: SELECT DISTINCT c.artist AS illustrator, l.format FROM cards AS c LEFT JOIN legalities AS l ON l.uuid = c.uuid WHERE c.artist = (SELECT MIN(artist) FROM cards) ORDER BY l.format;

d.request: Who illustrated the fewest cards, and what are the play formats of those cards? Include cards even if they have no matching legalities record.
d.sql: WITH artist_counts AS (SELECT artist, COUNT(*) AS card_count FROM cards WHERE artist IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(artist) <> '' GROUP BY artist) SELECT c.artist, c.name AS card_name, l.format FROM cards AS c JOIN artist_counts AS ac ON ac.artist = c.artist LEFT JOIN legalities AS l ON l.uuid = c.uuid WHERE ac.card_count = (SELECT MIN(card_count) FROM artist_counts) ORDER BY c.artist, c.name, l.format;

b.request: Which artist illustrated the fewest cards, and what are the play formats for those cards, including cards with no matching legalities record?
b.sql: WITH artist_counts AS (SELECT artist, COUNT(*) AS card_count FROM cards WHERE artist IS NOT NULL GROUP BY artist), fewest AS (SELECT MIN(card_count) AS card_count FROM artist_counts) SELECT c.artist, c.name AS card_name, l.format FROM cards AS c JOIN artist_counts AS ac ON ac.artist = c.artist JOIN fewest AS f ON f.card_count = ac.card_count LEFT JOIN legalities AS l ON l.uuid = c.uuid ORDER BY c.artist, c.name, l.format;
